description: This Java class 'GlAccountSheetPopulator' is responsible for populating an Excel sheet with GL Account data, including setting up the sheet layout, writing account details, and protecting the sheet. It is part of the bulk import infrastructure in the Apache Fineract project.
external_methods: writeString(int columnIndex, Row row, String value)
writeLong(int columnIndex, Row row, Long value)

classes.name: GlAccountSheetPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel sheet with GL Account data, including layout setup and data insertion. It extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator and is used in bulk import operations to generate the GL accounts sheet.

methods.name: GlAccountSheetPopulator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the populator with a list of GLAccountData objects.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the provided Workbook with GL account data, creating a sheet and filling it with account details.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the column widths and headers in the sheet.

methods.name: populateglAccounts
methods.description: Fills the sheet with GL account data, creating a row for each account.

methods.name: getGlAccountNamesSize
methods.description: Returns the number of GL account entries.
